decisions.reason: As an expanding, broad-range machinery supplier with in-house R&D and organizational slack, the firm is likely to keep this adjacent product unless its sales clearly fell below aspirations, and the available evidence does not show such a shortfall.

Because this filter builds directly on the firm’s established fluid-handling and filtration business, it likely meets strategic and performance aspirations well enough to remain in the portfolio, especially in a growing industry and an investing firm.

This product is close to the core offer and supports the firm’s one-stop modular systems logic, so with current expansion and resource slack management would more likely retain it than reallocate its resources elsewhere.
